name: python-namespace-package-identity
body:
PEP-420 namespace packages (directories with `__init__.py` absent) contribute their directory path to module identity. `rust.pyfrontend.Scanner.module_fqn_for` walks up all namespace-package ancestors: `pkg/mod.py` and `other/mod.py` receive distinct identities `pkg.mod` and `other.mod`.

Acceptance criteria:
- A module inside a namespace package gets a dotted identity that includes its package directory path.
- `pkg/mod.py` and `other/mod.py` receive distinct identities.
- A regular (init-bearing) package's identity is unchanged.
